name: Structural Insights into Atoms and Molecules
description: Schrodinger equation and its application to model systems: particle in a box (electronic transition, free electron models), harmonic oscillator and understanding the vibrational transitions in diatomic molecules, rigid rotor and rotational transitions, hydrogen atom, and hydrogenic orbitals; bonding in molecules: variational theorem, LCAO-MO, H2+ molecular ion, concept of bonding and anti-bonding molecular orbitals; electronic and vibrational spectroscopy for structural analysis.
